failure.title: Resource snapshot missed healthy workers after Next rewrote their process titles
failure.note: The retained targeted live proof shows /health/live returning HTTP 200, one web-cluster primary, and two workers with exact slots 1 and 2 and runtime titles next-server (v16.2.12). The exact pre-fix image source and repeatable exit-1 stack record Expected exactly 2 web workers, found 0 before any resource report was collected.
failure.diagnosis: Worker discovery treated the pre-import docker/spotter-worker.mjs command line as stable process identity. Next rewrites process.title to next-server (v16.2.12) after the worker imports the standalone server, while the SPOTTER_WEB_CLUSTER_WORKER and slot environment markers remain intact. The two healthy workers therefore existed but were removed by the harness predicate.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
